summary: Sun-kissed authenticity. A sheer, long-wearing fluid designed to recreate the irregular, organic appearance of natural freckles.
description: Aesthetic organic detailing. This water-based tint features a specialized applicator that dots varying sizes of semi-translucent pigment, mimicking the random dispersion of natural melanin clusters.
technical_overview: Offered at $20.0 for 3ml, this KoColor FRECKLE_TINT is expertly formulated with Water, Glycerin, and specialized Dyes. It delivers a high-fidelity Sepia Melanin color profile (`#704214`) and leverages organic dispersion optics.

dynamic_attributes.label: Usage Notes
dynamic_attributes.body: Dot sparsely across the nose and cheeks, then immediately tap with a fingertip to diffuse.

dynamic_attributes.label: Expert Tip
dynamic_attributes.body: Tap the brush lightly against your finger to splatter the product for an ultra-realistic, randomized application.

dynamic_attributes.label: Formulation Insight
dynamic_attributes.body: The sheer dye base ensures the tint melts into the skin's tone rather than sitting opaquely on top.
